notes:
**Writing and moving text**, **who sees what in the side bar**, and **AW Server** with its own icon and tray.

- **Text into a new document:** select text, choose a type and a name – it moves there and stays embedded where it stood.
- **Side bar:** who sees and changes a document or a section is set there; the document's name and its infobox open their settings. A document under cover can be linked under its alias without giving it away.
- **Embedded documents and sections** read exactly as on their own page.
- **Browser import:** content imported again replaces what the world holds of it, and shows in the open world right away.
- **AW Server:** its own icon, a tray menu to start and stop it, the admin ID taken from the app, always reachable on the local network; the app keeps off its port.
- **Server backups** at a time of day, weekly on a weekday (needs this server version).
- **Phone:** backups and the profile live in *Documents/AnotherWorldbuilder* and outlast reinstalling; Back closes what is open.
- **Look:** new icons, Ember colours by default (Night to choose), a smoother loader.
